[LSIG.1.5.3] The rectangle rule is exact for the piecewise-constant fact
model. It is not exact for a continuously-varying physical signal: the
absolute error is at most `granularity × W`, where `granularity` is the
slot's meaningful-change tolerance τ where declared ([LFAC.2.5.1]) or the
sensor quantisation step otherwise. An author integrating a fast-varying
rate who needs second-order accuracy on the closed history may apply the
trapezoid rule in the adapter; the open right-boundary interval has no
successor sample and reduces to the rectangle rule regardless.
